description.en: Control YoLink smart-home devices from your YoLink account using User Access Credentials. Turn switches, outlets, and valve controllers on and off, and monitor temperature/humidity sensors, door, motion, leak, and vibration sensors, and battery levels. Realtime updates arrive over YoLink's cloud, with polling as a fallback. All supported devices on the account are added automatically.

value.en: In the YoLink app, open Account -> Advanced Settings -> User Access Credentials and tap Generate. On the next screen, enter the User Access Id (UAID) and Secret Key. All supported devices on the account will be added.
